title: Session states with multiple sessions
description: Count sessions for each state and keep only states with at least 2 sessions. Return exactly two columns: state, session_count. Sort by session_count DESC, then state ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS session_count
FROM sessions
hints: After GROUP BY, a COUNT condition belongs in HAVING.
The session_count alias can be used in ORDER BY.
solution_explanation: HAVING filters already formed groups by the aggregate count.
